% Generated by roxygen2: do not edit by hand
% Please edit documentation in R/parlay_ranked_portfolio.R
\name{parlay_evaluate_portfolio}
\alias{parlay_evaluate_portfolio}
\title{Evaluate a ranked role candidate pool into a funded delivery plan}
\usage{
parlay_evaluate_portfolio(
  portfolio,
  budget_cny = NULL,
  group_budget_cny = 256,
  reuse_policy,
  overlap_policy,
  improve = TRUE
)
}
\arguments{
\item{portfolio}{Ranked candidate pool from \code{\link[=parlay_construct_role_groups]{parlay_construct_role_groups()}}. Its
embedded cutoff, hashes, ranked-selection receipt, masks, group patterns and
substitutions are all re-validated; a tampered leg, mask, rank, hash or cutoff
fails closed.}

\item{budget_cny}{Total decision budget in CNY, or \code{NULL} (default) for
unlimited. A finite value is used in whole ticket units; a zero or sub-unit
budget buys nothing and consumes no constraint. With \code{NULL}, \code{unspent_cny} is
\code{NA_real_}, never a fake zero.}

\item{group_budget_cny}{Per-group budget in CNY, default \code{256}. \code{NULL} means the
group buys its FULL legal support space; otherwise the cap is the smaller of
the given amount and the group's full-support cost, floored to whole units.}

\item{reuse_policy}{Named list with exactly \code{max_reuse}: a single positive whole
number, or \code{NULL} for unlimited. It governs every actual fixture in every
actual group; there is no role exemption.}

\item{overlap_policy}{Named list with exactly \code{max_overlap}: a single
non-negative whole number, or \code{NULL} for unlimited pairwise overlap. A fixture
that is a role-3 leg in BOTH compared groups is exempt from the count; every
other shared fixture counts.}

\item{improve}{Logical scalar (default \code{TRUE}). \code{TRUE} runs the bounded
improvement stage over allowed ranked directions and recorded fallback
structures, accepting only a strict whole-portfolio union-coverage gain.
\code{FALSE} returns the unimproved walk with a typed-empty \code{changes} table.}
}
\value{
A named list:
\itemize{
\item \code{summary} -- actual selected group count, new ticket count, spent cash,
\code{unspent_cny} (\code{NA_real_} under an unlimited total budget), nominal and
ACTUAL union coverage, and a nullable EV availability flag;
\item \code{group_selection} -- one row per candidate group in the initial nominal
order with its target/actual pattern, nominal and actual coverage, tickets
and spend;
\item \code{purchases} -- the actual purchase ledger (one row per owned physical
ticket, charged exactly once);
\item \code{funded_ledger} -- the ledger joined to its group attribution;
\item \code{rejections} -- every refused candidate with its exact reason
(\code{no_new_tickets}, \code{reuse_cap_exceeded}, \code{overlap_cap_exceeded});
\item \code{selection} -- the full per-candidate audit including \code{nominal_coverage},
\code{actual_coverage} and \code{reason};
\item \code{changes} -- accepted improvement moves; typed-empty when \code{improve = FALSE};
\item \code{plan} -- the frozen plan consumable by \code{\link[=parlay_settle_plan]{parlay_settle_plan()}};
\item \code{tickets} -- the per-ticket table of the actual purchases;
\item \code{diagnostics}, \code{receipt}, \code{cutoff}, \code{initial}, \code{final} -- provenance and the
source-pool vs improved views, preserved separately without hidden mutation.
}
}
\description{
Successor to the obsolete score-table evaluator (#537). It consumes the ranked
candidate pool from \code{\link[=parlay_construct_role_groups]{parlay_construct_role_groups()}} and performs the bounded,
deterministic funding walk described in the file header: per-group enumeration
inside the authoritative mask, nominal priority by legal top-N mass, admission
under explicit reuse/overlap policies, physical-ticket de-duplication with
down-rank continuation, and ACTUAL coverage recomputed from the owned tickets.
}
\section{Provenance}{

The receipt binds the exact input hashes (portfolio, ranked selections,
probabilities, pre-match SP, settings), the resolved policies and budgets, the
embedded cutoff and a transitive code hash. Nothing is fitted, no EV parameter
is learned and the \code{portfolio} argument is never mutated.
}

\section{Mandatory complementary purchase}{
Actual double fixtures with draw ranked third and raw draw probability strictly
above 0.20 require Top1+Top2 and Top1+draw in two different groups, each realized
by both outcomes on its own purchased tickets. Missing partners roll back the
entire tentative bundle without consuming money or reuse quota.
Seeds and partners follow stable nominal priority, with finite greedy obligation
expansion and no exhaustive backtracking. Triple-only fixtures are exempt, and a
triple elsewhere cannot discharge a double obligation.
The returned \code{complement} tibble records fixture IDs, main/protect owning
groups and satisfaction. Rejections can include \code{forced_complement_unavailable}.
}
\examples{
cutoff <- list(issue_id = "26098",
               cutoff_utc = as.POSIXct("2026-09-26 12:00:00", tz = "UTC"))
matches <- tibble::tibble(
  fixture_id = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  win = c(0.45, 0.40, 0.50, 0.30),
  draw = c(0.27, 0.30, 0.30, 0.30),
  lose = c(0.28, 0.30, 0.20, 0.40))
ranked <- rank_outcome_selections(prepare_outcome_selections(matches), cutoff)
settings <- parlay_settings()
settings$n_legs <- 2L
pool <- parlay_construct_role_groups(ranked, settings, pattern = c(3L, 2L),
                                     max_candidates = 2L)
evaluation <- parlay_evaluate_portfolio(
  pool, group_budget_cny = 4, budget_cny = 8,
  reuse_policy = list(max_reuse = 1L),
  overlap_policy = list(max_overlap = 0L), improve = FALSE)
evaluation$summary
}
